definition: Previous = held-out 400 (runs/heldout400, 100 per type); latest = final500 MultiHop-RAG (runs/final500, 125 per type). Per question type only; no pooled MultiHop-RAG numbers. 'latest_on_previous_400' = latest run restricted to the previous run's questions.
notes: Latest Normal RAG, RAPTOR and HippoRAG reuse the previous run's answers (same run folders) on the 400 and answered 25 new questions per type; only Agentic Hybrid RAG was re-run (new version) on all 500. Previous answered-right uses the previous Haiku answer verdicts, latest the fresh Haiku answer judge. judge/excluded_records.json lists only 2 Natural Questions ids, so no MultiHop-RAG question is left out.

data_sources.previous: runs/heldout400/runs/<method>/<timestamp>/results.jsonl, the r1-r3 folders listed in runs/heldout400/manifest.jsonl (r2 Agentic is the r2resume folders plus the 20261101T231404 resume folders). Latency pass: the 4 'latency' folders in the same manifest (40 questions per method, 10 per type, 1 worker).
data_sources.latest: the folders in runs/final500/run_registry.json['multihop_rag']: Normal RAG, RAPTOR and HippoRAG are the previous run's r1-r3 folders for the 400 plus 2 new folders per repeat (runs/<method>/20261113T0941*-0942*) for the 100 new questions; Agentic Hybrid RAG is 6 new folders per repeat (runs/graphrag/20261113T0948*-0949*). runs/final500/multihop_rag/<method>/r* hold no extra timing data. No one-worker latency pass exists for the latest run (searched runs/final500 jobs, logs, scripts, STATUS/DECISIONS).
data_sources.fields: Latency = retrieval_and_answer_seconds (wall clock from the start of retrieval to the end of the answer, per question); model_seconds = time inside API calls. Tokens = question_cost.calls[*].input_tokens / output_tokens (API usage per call; output includes reasoning). Query cost = list_question_cost_usd, re-derived from those tokens at settings.json pricing (gpt-6-luna $0.10/M input, $0.50/M output, no cached-input discount; text-embedding-3-small $0.02/M); identical pricing block in both runs.

1_significance.definition: Per question, right = right in >=2 of 3 repeats. Exact two-sided McNemar on Agentic-only vs baseline-only right counts. p_holm_12 = Holm over the 12 per-type tests of each run (3 baselines x 4 types). Wins/ties/losses compare the mean over 3 repeats per question.
1_significance.notes: The poster's Holm p used 15 tests (incl. a pooled 'all' row); with the pooled row dropped Holm is over 12, so previous Holm p differ from the poster (e.g. temporal vs Normal RAG 0.492 -> 0.422). Raw p, wins/ties/losses and discordant counts reproduce insights.json exactly. Agentic Hybrid RAG is a different version in each run; the baselines are the same answers on the 400.

3b_null_yesno.definition: Answers = question x repeat. Null type: share of answers that are 'Insufficient Information'. Answerable types: share that abstain (false 'insufficient'). Yes/no questions (gold 'yes'/'no', comparison and temporal only): first word of the answer, refusals, accuracy by gold label.
3b_null_yesno.notes: Inference and null questions have no yes/no golds.

5b_latency.definition: retrieval_and_answer_seconds per answer over all 3 repeats of the main runs: median, p90, mean; model_share_of_time = sum(model_seconds)/sum(seconds). Previous also: its one-worker latency pass (what the poster showed), 10 questions per type.
5b_latency.notes: Main-run timings are taken under load. threads_per_process is each folder's 'concurrency' field; parallel_processes gives how many run folders of that method ran at the same time (from started_at + seconds). The latest run has no one-worker pass, so the only like-for-like latency comparison is main-run vs main-run, and load differs (see parallel_processes).

5d_total_cost.definition: Query cost per question = mean list_question_cost_usd over the type's answers (3 repeats). Total = one-time build (whole corpus, list USD) + N x query cost per question, N = the type's questions once (100 / 125), all 3 repeats (300 / 375), or 10,000.
5d_total_cost.notes: The build is one index for the whole MultiHop-RAG corpus and cannot be split by type; it is the same figure in both runs because the latest run reused the previous indexes (SPEC 'multihop_indexes: no rebuild'; only one index folder per method exists under runs/<method>/indexes; the latest Agentic run folders' build_cost.json are $0). Build figures were not metered during the build; their sources are in build_sources.
